Du möchtest innovative KI- und Automatisierungslösungen für den Kundenservice verantworten und ihre Weiterentwicklung aktiv gestalten? Wir suchen Menschen mit Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im Customer-Service- oder Contact-Center-Umfeld. Verstärke unser Team am Standort Hamburg oder Leipzig zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Product Owner Agent Assist & User Platforms (m/w/d).
Das bieten wir
Sicherer Arbeitsplatz : Arbeite Vollzeit in einem unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnis in einem krisensicheren, wachstumsorientierten Umfeld
Hybrides Arbeiten: Nutze die Möglichkeit, flexibel von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten, als Teil unserer modernen Arbeitswelt
Team- und Firmenevents: Nimm regelmäßig an spannenden Events teil und fördere den Teamgeist

Deine Aufgaben
Verantworte die Produktvision, Roadmap und Weiterentwicklung unserer Agent-Assist- und Automatisierungsplattformen entlang der Unternehmensstrategie

Entwickle innovative KI-gestützte Agent-Assist-Funktionen für Telefonie, Chat und E-Mail – von Echtzeit-Empfehlungen über automatisierte Zusammenfassungen bis zur Integration von Wissensdatenbanken
Arbeite eng mit Operations, Data Science, IT-Entwicklung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen und begleite die Einführung neuer Lösungen bis in den operativen Einsatz
Fördere die Nutzerakzeptanz unserer Produkte, leite Optimierungspotenziale aus KPIs und Nutzerfeedback ab und stelle einen nachhaltigen Business-Impact sicher
Präsentiere Produktfortschritte, moderiere Workshops und bereite Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Stakeholder auf

abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im Contact-Center-, BPO- oder Customer-Service-Umfeld
fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Integration von IT-Lösungen, insbesondere im Bereich Contact-Center-Technologien, Voice Services und Cloud-Plattformen
Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Systemlandschaften sowie moderner Integrationslösungen

Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen (z. B. Scrum oder Kanban) sowie gängigen Tools wie Jira oder Confluence
Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern im verhandlungssicheren Deutsch und Englisch

The eRA Product Manager within Notre Dame Research serves as the strategic owner of the University’s electronic Research Administration (eRA) ecosystem. This position is responsible for the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of the administrative systems that support the University’s research enterprise.

The eRA Product Manager partners closely with Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and external software vendors to ensure research administration and compliance platforms align with institutional priorities, federal compliance requirements, and the evolving needs of faculty and research staff.

In this role, the eRA Product Manager acts as a high-level consultant to University leadership, translating strategic research objectives into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data integrity, compliance readiness, and proposal competitiveness.

Most immediately, the successful candidate in collaboration with the Associate Vice President of Research and the Director of Research Effectiveness and Analytics will play a defining leadership role in steering the University through a major eRA implementation, shaping the future of Notre Dame’s research infrastructure from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities Define, manage, and execute the product roadmap for the University’s electronic Research Administration systems, prioritizing enhancements and feature releases that streamline workflows and reduce administrative burden.

Serve as the primary liaison between Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and third-party software vendors to advocate for institutional needs and influence product development.

Lead system governance and integration strategy for research administration platforms, ensuring effective data exchange between eRA systems, HRIS, ERP, and other enterprise applications. Oversee research data governance practices to establish consistent standards, improve data quality, and support reliable institutional reporting and analytics.

Configure and maintain system validations and workflows to support evolving federal regulations and sponsor requirements, including NSF, NIH, USDA, and other compliance standards. Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and enhanced reporting capabilities.

Develop and maintain system documentation, business processes, and training materials to support successful adoption of system enhancements and transitions. Lead “train-the-trainer” initiatives and support change management efforts across the research community.

Monitor system performance, user feedback, and emerging industry trends to inform continuous improvement efforts. Support reporting and data visualization activities to translate research administration data into actionable insights for leadership decision-making.

Support audit readiness activities by ensuring accurate system configurations, data integrity, and compliance documentation. Participate in vendor user groups, professional organizations, and research administration communities to stay informed on best practices and emerging technologies.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Research Administration, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in research administration, enterprise systems management, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in a leadership, Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar strategic systems role.

Experience supporting enterprise-level software implementations, preferably within research administration, ERP, or higher education environments. Expert understanding of the research grant lifecycle, including pre-award, post-award, and compliance functions.

Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, integrations, and data governance principles. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct supervisory authority. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify operational trends.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including faculty and senior leadership. Ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a dynamic environment. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail and compliance requirements.

Preferred qualifications Experience working within higher education research administration environments. Familiarity with eRA systems, ERP platforms, and SaaS-to-on-premises data integrations. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Knowledge of federal research compliance regulations and sponsored program administration. Please include a cover letter and resume to be considered for this role. Salary up to $113,500, commensurate with experience. Applications due by July 27 2026.

The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment.

Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit.

Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world.

Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you! Originally posted on Himalayas

Who is Credible ?
Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level.

On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score.

On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.
About the Role: Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data.

Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders. This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build.

In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler.

Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant. Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the product's vision and direction and to achieve team OKRs. Responsibilities:
Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible 's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the student loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
Own the Roadmap: Manage roadmaps for both private student loans and student loan refinance products by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove when it isn't earning its place.
Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

At least 4 years of experience in a Product Management role for web-based consumer Internet products
Bachelor's Degree
Deep, demonstrated fluency using AI tools in your actual workflow for prototyping, analysis, research synthesis, and writing, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don't
Genuine interest in and ideas about building AI-powered product experiences, not just using AI to work faster
Ability to bring working concepts to life, whether through AI tooling, light coding, or strong partnership with engineering
Familiarity with how to evaluate AI output quality, or clear aptitude and appetite to own it
Ability to use data, your experience, and product instincts to identify the most impactful areas of focus, including running your own analysis
Strong analytical abilities across spreadsheets, SQL, and other analytics tools
Exceptional problem-solving and communication skills
Strong project management skills, and willingness/ability to own critical parts of the product, end-to-end
Thrive on collaboration with other teams to accomplish shared goals
Technical aptitude sufficient to work closely with engineers, evaluate implementation approaches, and weigh cost/benefit tradeoffs
A bias toward experimentation and the discipline to walk away from your own ideas when the evidence says so

Dominio de metodologías ágiles para la gestión de productos y la coordinación con equipos.

Liderar el ciclo de vida de las soluciones digitales: discovery, definición, planificación, entrega y mejora continua.
Transformar iniciativas de negocio en un backlog claro, priorizado y mantenido (con criterios de valor, alcance y dependencias).

Dominar metodologías ágiles (por ejemplo, Scrum/Kanban) y asegurar prácticas saludables de trabajo con los equipos.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. About the Role Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, AI to own a defined capability area within the AI portfolio across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise.

Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, this Senior PM partners closely with engineering, sales and GTM, marketing, and the broader AI organization to ship capabilities that solve real problems for our enterprise ICP.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch — at the center of one of the most consequential shifts in enterprise data infrastructure.

Product execution within a defined AI capability area: End-to-end ownership of one or more capabilities inside the AI portfolio. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption — and the iteration after launch. You contribute to the strategy for the wider portfolio area you sit within, working with the Principal PM and the VP of AI Product Management who set it.
Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.
Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.
Customer and design partner engagement: Support and run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.
Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across the broader product organization — Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team — so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area: build where Couchbase is uniquely strong, and surface partnerships and integrations where we can deliver a better customer experience faster.
Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win in the capabilities you own — positioning, demos, competitive context, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.
External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.
AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, roadmap modeling, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team's AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.
Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.
What You Will Deliver
PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.
Shipped capabilities in your area with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.
Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.
Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.
Contributions to the broader AI portfolio narrative — customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.
Visible AI-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, developer tools, or AI infrastructure.
Technical fluency in modern AI infrastructure: vector search, embeddings, RAG, agent frameworks, model serving, context engineering, and emerging interoperability standards. You can hold your own with engineering on architecture.
Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

A1M Solutions is a woman-owned small business driven by the aspiration to provide value to our customers, employees, partners, and community while remaining aligned to our guiding principles of foundational values, deliberate focus, and empathetic connection.
A1M’s mission is to preserve and improve government healthcare programs that are lifelines for underserved people in the United States, including people in poverty, elderly people, members of ethnic and racial minorities, immigrants, and refugees. Besides building useful and usable digital services, A1M helps teams improve their agile, user-centered design practices – or helps them get started. Our goal is not just to build sustainable public services, but also to leave our teaming partners and customers more skilled and more confident in the future.
Technology Delivery at A1M
Product Managers report into the Product Practice at A1M. They help teams execute on a vision, and craft a project strategy. They work in cross-functional, cross-organizational teams, often with policy experts and specialists as well as coordinating with technical teams.
Product management in government involves weaving inputs from stakeholders, policy domain experts, users, and technical partners into a unified path forward. This is particularly true for the lifeline government healthcare programs that serve millions of people. Listening, communication, and prioritization skills are more important to success than technical or business innovation.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work with minimal guidance to carry out product management work with cross-functional teams. You will define a compelling vision, generate a clear strategy to achieve it, then work with teams and partners to build out an agile roadmap for delivery. You are excited to build high functional teams and cooperative relationships.
It’s wonderful if you have a background in policy or healthcare, but you don’t need to have deep knowledge. What we do expect is that you enjoy building relationships across organizational boundaries and treat the contributions from other domains and functions as crucial for product success. Senior PMs do not have formal people management responsibilities, but skills in teaching and coaching are essential.

About Qorelo
Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.
This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.
What you'll own
The product roadmap. You prioritize what our AI agents learn to do next across the transformation lifecycle — from fit-to-standard analysis to post-go-live evolution — and you can defend every call with customer evidence.
The solution architects. You lead our two SAs directly, turning their module knowledge and project scar tissue into product requirements engineering can build against.
Discovery with real users. Consultants and enterprise IT teams use Qorelo inside live transformation programmes. You sit with them, watch where the product wins and where it fails, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.
The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.
Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.
What you need
4+ years hands-on SAP experience, functional or product side — S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area like FI, SD, or PP
2+ years product experience: you've owned a roadmap, prioritized with engineering, and shipped features to real users — title doesn't matter, ownership does
Understanding of the SAP transformation lifecycle (Discover → Prepare → Explore → Realize) deep enough to talk credibly to consultants and IT leads at enterprise clients

Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, IC work alongside strategy

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.

Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact
Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback

Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops
Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.
How We Work
The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.

Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.
At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.
The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for.

That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.
We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.
This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.
(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)
_________________________________________________________________________________________
We are Shape.Construction!
We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION
It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest - 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it).
We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.
We are building a full suite of products one module at a time - kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech
The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.
This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.
4 core values for a good life
We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:
Grow yourself - Your relationship with yourself
Care about people - Your relationship with others around you
Execute to greatness - Your relationship with your team
Build civilisation - Your relationship with humanity and the world

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.
You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. On one side, the site: supervisors, field engineers and site managers working in conditions where an app has about five seconds to prove it's worth opening.

On the other, the office: project directors, commercial directors and quantity surveyors who need to trust what they're looking at enough to make a call on it. Value only appears when those two sides connect, and that connection is what we build.
Depending on where you're strongest and what the business needs, you might own the field side, the commercial side, or the seam between them. In every case the standard is the same: real adoption by people who have no obligation to use us, and a concrete outcome for the project as a result.
You'll also be at the front of how AI shows up in our products. A meaningful part of our ambition depends on AI doing genuinely hard things well in a domain with very little tolerance for confident nonsense, the stakes for our users are commercial and often contractual. You'll be the person who decides where AI earns its place, and where it doesn't.
Team
You'll be part of our Product team, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and our consultancy delivery teams, who are on live projects every day and are the sharpest feedback loop any product team could ask for. You'll also work closely with growth and customer success to make sure what we build reaches the people who need it.

Own the outcome: You will own a product area end to end, the problem, the strategy, the roadmap and the results. You'll define what success looks like in customer and commercial terms, and you'll be honest about whether we hit it.
Get close to the problem, on both sides: You'll spend real time on live projects, in the site cabin and in the commercial meeting, with our consultancy teams, and in the data. You'll build a deeper understanding of how a construction project actually runs, and of the commercial machinery behind it, than most people in our industry have, and use it to make sharp calls about what to build and what to refuse.

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.
We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.
As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value.

Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.
If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.
Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.
Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.
Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.
Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.
What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.
Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.
Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.
Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.
High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.
Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.
Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.
Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.
Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Schneider Geospatial is a leading PE-backed GovTech SaaS company transforming how governments serve their communities. Our GIS-based GovTech solutions power over 1,000 local governments across 34 states. We help public agencies streamline parcel management, permitting & licensing, and asset management, making government more transparent, efficient, and citizen focused.
Recognized multiple years as a Great Employer to Work For, we blend a purpose-driven mission with the innovation and agility of a high-growth software company. The Opportunity
We're seeking a Product Manager, Parcel Management, to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of one of Schneider Geospatial 's flagship product lines. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), you'll partner with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that help local governments manage parcel data, support property assessment and taxation workflows, and provide reliable public access to property information.
You'll combine strategic product thinking with a deep curiosity for how assessors, auditors, treasurers, GIS teams, and other local government professionals work, translating complex parcel and property-data challenges into intuitive, scalable software that improves accuracy, efficiency, and transparency.
This is a unique opportunity to own a high-impact product in a PE-backed company entering an exciting phase of growth and modernization. You'll shape product strategy, influence customer outcomes, and help define the next generation of parcel management and public access solutions.

Mission + Impact: Build technology that helps local governments better serve citizens and businesses.
Ownership + Innovation: Lead a flagship product with meaningful ownership and strategic influence.
Growth + Learning: Partner with experienced product and executive leaders committed to mentorship and professional development.

Translate customer feedback, market trends, evolving data standards, and competitive insights into a compelling product roadmap.
Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI, automation, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to modernize parcel workflows, improve data quality, and create meaningful customer value.

About Pelico
Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews : please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.
This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides.

You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption.

You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.

Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.
Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.
Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.
Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.
Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.
Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.
Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.
Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.

A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.
Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.
The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.
Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.
A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.
Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.
What you’ll need
Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.
Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.
The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.
The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.
Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.
Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.
What success looks like
Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.
Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.
As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass , while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.
The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass .

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role.

You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds.

Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you
accordingly.

Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.

· Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.

· Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.

· Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.

· Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.

· Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.

· Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.

· Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.

· Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.

· A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.

· Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.

· Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.

· A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.

· Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.

· Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.

· Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.

· Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.

· A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.

· Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.

· Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

· Bilingual English and French.

You will own client outcomes, not status reports.

· Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.

· Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.

· You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.

· Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

Product Manager/in mit Verkauf \& Einkauf 100 % (m/w/d)
=======================================================
Unser Kunde, gehört zu den führenden Anbietern von exklusiven Bedarfsartikeln für die **Landschafts\-Architektur und dem Landschaftsbau**. Für das 4er Produkt Management \- Verkaufsinnendienst Team suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n
**Product Manager/in** mit Verkauf \& Einkauf 90\-100 % (m/w/d)
----------------------------------------------------------------
Ob Sie bereits Branchenerfahrung mitbringen, spielt keine Rolle: Entscheidend sind für uns Ihr **Drive, Ihre Lernbereitschaft, Ihr Interesse an Produkten, Kunden und Märkten sowie Ihre Freude daran, gemeinsam mit anderen Lösungen zu finden.**.
### **Was ist Ihre Verantwortung?**
In dieser vielseitigen Position arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Product Management, Verkauf und Einkauf. Sie gestalten unser Sortiment aktiv mit, bringen Markt\- und Kundenbedürfnisse ein und unterstützen dabei, unsere Produkte laufend weiterzuentwickeln. Sie werden von einem erfahrenen Team begleitet und erhalten gleichzeitig Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen.
* Sie sind mitverantwortlich für die Sortimentsgestaltung und \-optimierung, damit wir unseren Kunden passende und überzeugende Lösungen anbieten können.
* Sie analysieren Markt\- und Kundenbedürfnisse und bringen Ideen für neue Produkte, Anpassungen oder Verbesserungen ein.
* Sie arbeiten eng mit Verkauf, Marketing, Einkauf und Lager zusammen, damit Ideen auch in der Praxis sauber umgesetzt werden.
* Sie sind Ansprechperson für spezifische Kundenanfragen, erstellen Offerten und unterstützen bei der Beratung zu unserem Produktsortiment.
* Je nach Erfahrung und Einarbeitungsphase sind Sie auch direkt in die Kundenberatung eingebunden. Der telefonische Kundenkontakt hilft Ihnen, unsere Kunden, Produkte und Abläufe und praxisnah kennenzulernen.
* Sie pflegen den Kontakt zu Kunden und Lieferanten und bauen tragfähige Beziehungen auf.
### **Das bringen Sie mit**
* Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Grundlage.
* Erste Berufserfahrung ist willkommen. Wichtig sind Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und der Wille, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
* Wenn Sie bereits Erfahrung mitbringen, freuen wir uns über Ihr Wissen – ebenso wichtig ist uns aber, dass Sie offen bleiben, Neues lernen und bestehende Lösungen hinterfragen.
* Sie sind neugierig, denken mit und wollen verstehen, wie **Produkte, Kundenbedürfnisse, Verkauf und Einkauf zusammenhängen.**
* Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind zuverlässig und bringen eine gesunde Portion Eigeninitiative kommunizieren offen, klar und respektvoll.
* Sie gehen gerne auf Menschen zu und haben Freude am Kontakt mit Kunden und an Gartenthemen, Architektur oder technischen Produkten ist ein Plus.
* Sie verfügen über fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und **mittlere bis gute mündliche Französischkenntnisse (ab B1\)**.
### **Warum zu uns?**
* Sie erhalten eine vielseitige und selbständige Aufgabe mit Nähe zu Produkt, Markt, Verkauf und Einkauf.
* Sie werden von einem engagierten Team begleitet und können Verantwortung übernehmen.
* Wir bieten Ihnen ein dynamisches Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
* Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was Sie schon können, sondern auch, was Sie lernen und bewegen wollen.
* Sie arbeiten in einem Unternehmen mit rund 50 Jahren Geschichte, das sich laufend weiterentwickelt.
Bitte senden Sie Ihren Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse **via E\-Mail** an Herr G. Pilot (at). Er wird sich nach Erhalt Ihrer Unterlagen umgehend bei Ihnen melden. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung und sichern Ihnen volle Diskretion und eine rasche Abwicklung zu.

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the core marketplace experience. We’re rethinking things from the ground up—you won’t be inheriting a roadmap, a backlog, or a set of conventions. You’ll be building the product from the ground up alongside the CPTO.
This role requires someone who thinks in systems. A marketplace is not a single product—it’s an ecosystem. You’ll need to hold the consumer experience, the practitioner experience, the matching logic, the trust and safety layer, the business model, and the growth loops in your head simultaneously, and make smart tradeoffs between them every day.
You will report directly to the CPTO and work alongside a small, senior engineering team. There are no layers between you and the work, and no layers between you and the decisions that shape the company.

Product Strategy & Vision
Define the product vision and strategy for the marketplace, grounded in deep user understanding, competitive analysis, and a clear-eyed view of the business model.
Own the roadmap end-to-end. Decide what to build, what to kill, and what to sequence—with conviction, not consensus.
Develop and maintain a strong point of view on where the wellness and longevity market is heading and how our product should evolve to lead, not follow.
TRUE 0→1 product thinking: identify the fastest and cheapest ways to validate core assumptions before committing significant engineering investment.
Marketplace Systems Thinking
Design and optimize both sides of the marketplace: the consumer journey (discovery → trust → booking → retention) and the practitioner journey (onboarding → activation → growth → advocacy).
Develop frameworks for marketplace health: supply/demand balance, liquidity metrics, matching quality, and network effects.
Own the cold-start playbook. Figure out how to bootstrap supply and demand in new verticals and geographies.
Think critically about marketplace trust and safety—credential verification, reviews, dispute resolution—as a product surface, not an afterthought.
Execution & Shipping
Partner with engineering and design to ship continuously. Write clear, opinionated specs. Run structured discovery. Make scope decisions that keep velocity high.
Instrument everything. Define success metrics for every feature. Run experiments. Kill things that aren’t working.
Balance competing priorities across consumer, practitioner, and platform workstreams while maintaining a clear view of the overall system.
Business & Growth
Own the business logic of the marketplace: pricing models, take rates, subscription tiers, transaction economics.
Partner with growth and marketing on acquisition loops, activation funnels, and retention strategies for both sides of the marketplace.
Use data to identify the highest-leverage opportunities. Build the instrumentation and dashboards needed to operate with clarity.
AI as a Force Multiplier
AI should be part of your daily operating system as a product manager.
Research synthesis: distilling user interviews, market data, and competitive intel at speed.
Spec and strategy drafting: using AI to accelerate writing, then applying your judgment to sharpen it.
Data analysis: querying, visualizing, and interpreting data with AI assistance.
Prototyping: rapidly generating UI concepts, user flows, and copy variations.
Workflow automation: building personal and team workflows that eliminate toil.
Bring a perspective on how AI should be woven into the product itself—personalized recommendations, intelligent matching, automated practitioner tools.
Raise the AI fluency bar for the entire team. Share what’s working. Push others to adopt.

Experience & Background
7+ years of product management experience, with significant time on marketplace, platform, or multi-sided products.
You’ve been a startup founder, a founding PM, or an early employee who built 0→1 products with limited resources. You know what it’s like to ship when there’s no playbook, no established process, and no safety net.
You’ve operated at the Senior, Staff, or Principal level—or you’ve functioned at that altitude regardless of your title (common for founders and early-stage operators).
Proven ability to ship products that drive measurable business outcomes, not just features.
Domain Passion
You are passionate about wellness, longevity, and preventive health. This isn’t a box you’re checking—you have a personal connection to this space. Maybe you’ve seen the healthcare system fail someone you love. Maybe you’ve gone deep on your own health optimization. Maybe you’ve worked in healthtech and know firsthand how much better it could be.
You stay current on trends in functional medicine, longevity research, consumer health, and the evolving practitioner landscape.
Working Style
Exceptional product taste. You see what’s working, what’s not, and what’s missing—and you care about the details.
Clear, precise communicator—in writing, in specs, in conversation, and in a room with engineers.
Comfortable with ambiguity and pace. You don’t need permission to act. You don’t wait for perfect information.
Strong analytical chops. You pull your own data, run your own analyses, and let evidence shape your decisions.
Low ego, high ownership. You do what needs to be done—whether that’s writing a spec, responding to a user complaint, or fixing a broken onboarding email.

Direct experience in health, wellness, longevity, or consumer health—and an understanding of the regulatory, trust, and compliance dynamics of the space.
Experience building or scaling a marketplace through cold-start, supply/demand balancing, and network effects.
Experience building AI-native products (not just AI features bolted onto existing workflows).
Technical depth—you can read code, write SQL, or prototype in no-code/low-code tools.

We believe great people should be well paid and meaningfully invested in what they’re building . We hire individuals who raise the bar, and we compensate accordingly — with competitive salary, meaningful equity, and benefits designed to support your life and growth.

Equity: Meaningful early-stage equity package with standard 4-year vesting and 1-year cliff.

Retirement: 401(k) plan with tax-advantaged savings options

Notre équipe Digital Supply Chain recherche un·e Product Manager (f/m/d) en Stage, basé·e à Paris.
Au sein du domaine "Downstream Replenishment", notre collectif a pour mission de concevoir et de transformer les produits numériques qui optimisent la disponibilité de nos produits sportifs dans le monde entier. Composée de Product Managers, Data Scientists et Data Analysts, notre équipe fait le pont entre la tech et le business pour relever un défi de taille : acheminer le bon produit, au bon endroit, au bon moment, grâce à l'IA et aux modèles de données avancés.

En tant que Stagiaire Product Manager, tu rejoins une équipe agile. Ta mission principale sera de prendre en charge le déploiement international de l'un de nos produits numériques clés auprès de nos entrepôts et magasins.

Soutien au Déploiement et à la Scalabilité du Produit : Participer activement au déploiement opérationnel de notre solution de supply chain à l'échelle internationale et aider à son industrialisation.
Accompagnement au Changement : Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe pour accompagner les utilisateur·ices finaux·les (Supply Planners), faciliter l'adoption du produit et co-animer des sessions de formation.
Appui au User Discovery : Contribuer à recueillir les retours qualitatifs et quantitatifs du terrain pour aider l'équipe produit à enrichir la roadmap et à optimiser les fonctionnalités futures.
Suivi de la Performance : Aider à la mise en place et à l'analyse des indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs) liés à l'adoption du produit et à l'efficacité opérationnelle.
Vie de l'Équipe Agile : Participer activement aux rituels de l'équipe (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, rétrospectives) pour s'imprégner de la culture agile.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité curieuse, orientée solutions et dotée d'un excellent relationnel.
Formation : En cours de Master (Bac+5) en école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou équivalent universitaire.
Compétences relationnelles & Soft Skills : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques pour des profils business, esprit d'analyse et autonomie.
Appétences : Un fort intérêt pour les défis de la Supply Chain et la tech.
Langues : Anglais courant indispensable (contexte international quotidien). Le français est un plus.
Note importante : Si tu n'as pas d'expérience dans le sport mais que tu es passionné·e par les défis de la tech et de la supply chain, ta candidature a toute sa place chez nous !

Outils de gestion de produit & Agile (Jira, Confluence)
Outils d'analyse de données (Looker, SQL ou équivalents sont un plus)

At Reimagined Parking , we believe great people drive great results. That’s why we prioritize our teams, champion a positive culture, and relentlessly pursue excellence. We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Senior Data Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and growth of Reimagined Parking ’s commercial data products.

This role is responsible for identifying opportunities to turn Reimagined Parking ’s data, analytics, and insights into differentiated products and services that create measurable value for customers and the business.
The Senior Data Product Manager will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for commercial data products, working closely with customers, business leaders, commercial teams, data engineering, data science, analytics, and software development.

The role combines product management, data strategy, customer discovery, and commercial development. The successful candidate will understand customer problems and market opportunities, translate them into compelling data products, and work cross-functionally to bring those products to market and continuously improve them.

In addition to developing external-facing data products, this role will identify opportunities to leverage data products and analytics to improve Reimagined Parking ’s revenue, operational performance, customer experience, and decision-making. Key Responsibilities
Commercial Data Product Strategy
Define the vision and strategy for Reimagined Parking ’s commercial data product portfolio.
Identify and evaluate opportunities to transform proprietary data, analytics, and insights into products and services that deliver customer and commercial value.
Develop product business cases, including target customers, value propositions, use cases, competitive differentiation, revenue potential, and investment requirements.
Maintain a prioritized product roadmap aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and company strategy.
Establish product success metrics and measure customer adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, retention, and other key business outcomes.
Customer & Market Discovery
Partner with customers, prospects, sales, marketing, and business leaders to understand customer needs, pain points, and emerging market opportunities.
Conduct product discovery to validate customer problems and determine where data can provide meaningful competitive advantage or business value.
Translate customer and market insights into clear product requirements, use cases, and product opportunities.
Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and evolving expectations for data, analytics, and intelligence products.
Establish ongoing customer feedback loops to inform product development and prioritization.
Data Product Development
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and discovery through development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
Translate business and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Work closely with data engineering, data science, analytics, software engineering, and technology teams to deliver scalable and reliable data products.
Ensure data products are intuitive, actionable, performant, and fit for their intended customer use cases.
Balance customer requirements, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, data availability, and time-to-market when prioritizing product investments.
Define and manage product launches, releases, enhancements, and ongoing product improvements.
Data Commercialization & Monetization
Identify opportunities to commercialize Reimagined Parking ’s data assets through new products, services, insights, APIs, reporting, analytics, and other data-enabled offerings.
Partner with commercial leadership to support product positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement, and go-to-market strategies.
Develop compelling product value propositions that clearly articulate the business outcomes customers can achieve.
Evaluate opportunities for new revenue streams and expansion within existing customer relationships.
Monitor product and market performance to identify opportunities for growth, product expansion, and improved customer value.
Data-Enabled Business Outcomes
Identify opportunities to use commercial data products and analytics to improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business decision-making.
Establish clear business outcomes and KPIs for data products and measure value delivered after launch.
Use product and customer data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization.
Partner with internal business teams to ensure insights generated by data products are translated into actionable decisions and measurable outcomes.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the primary product leader connecting customers, commercial teams, business stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
Build strong relationships with sales, marketing, customer success, operations, finance, data engineering, data science, analytics, and software development.
Communicate product vision, strategy, priorities, and performance to stakeholders and leadership.
Lead cross-functional product teams through discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and optimization.
Create alignment around product priorities while effectively managing competing stakeholder needs.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
Proven experience (2 years) as a Data Product Manager or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
Strong understanding of data management, data analytics, and data visualization concepts.
Experience with data engineering, science and visualization technologies (e.g. Redshift, DBT, Microsoft Power BI)
Experience with Agile methodologies, product management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello), and version control systems (e.g., Git).
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven and detail-oriented mindset.
Experience in the parking industry is a plus.

s.h: Who is American College of Education
s.t:
Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.
ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.
The Product Manager, Student Acquisition owns the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the end-to-end student acquisition journey/value stream from prospective student through started student.

This role serves as the strategic bridge among Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, and IT, translating institutional growth goals and student needs into a prioritized, outcome-based product roadmap. The Product Manager aligns people, processes, data, and technology across the student acquisition technology ecosystem.

Success is measured through improved funnel conversion, faster decision-making and delivery, stronger operational efficiency, better prospective student experience, and clear accountability for the value delivered by technology investments.

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $145,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.
What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate
Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.

Wir bauen den Betrieb dieser Konzernplattform als eigene Organisation neu auf. Als Product Manager M365 verantwortest du, was auf dieser Plattform entsteht, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Nutzen für die Dienststellen und die Schulen.
Deine Aufgaben
* Du führst die Roadmap der M365-Plattform und priorisierst nach Wert und Risiko. Die Leitung sieht, was wann kommt, und kann steuern.
* Du baust den Zugang für die Dienststellen aus: eine Adresse für Anliegen, ein sichtbares Backlog, klare Zuständigkeit für jeden Entscheid. Kein Begehren versandet, keines geht an Entscheidungsgremien vorbei.
* Neue Dienste oder Apps bringst du zügig und nachweisbar zur Freigabe, gemeinsam mit Security, Datenschutz und den Fachverantwortlichen. Datenschutz ist für dich ein Qualitätsmerkmal und keine Bremse.
* Du machst transparent, was die Plattform und die einzelnen Dienste kosten, und legst sie verursachergerecht auf Verwaltung und Schulen um. Du unterstützt die Leitung bei der finanziellen Planung und Budgetierung.
* Du planst Rollouts mit Kommunikation und Befähigung und weist den Nutzen an Kennzahlen nach.
* Du baust das M365-Betriebsmodell mit auf, überführst Aufgaben vom externen Partner in die eigene Organisation und arbeitest im skalierten agilen Setup (SAFe) eng mit dem Product Owner, den DevOps Engineers, der Architektur und den Business Ownern zusammen.

Teams-, Meeting- und App-Policies, Berechtigungs- und Sharing-Modell in SharePoint Online und OneDrive, Gastzugriffe und deren Lebenszyklus in Entra ID, Sensitivity Labels und Purview, Voraussetzungen für Copilot, Sicherheitsbaselines wie CIS Benchmark und Secure Score.
